hypothesis.primary: A constrained 10-slot daily-close policy trained on daily-DB D-1 features (price/volume/flow) with exact 15:20 proxy execution achieves validation economic NAV above no-trade and at least equal to the best frozen RULE baseline at 0.23% round-trip cost.
hypothesis.null: The policy does not beat no-trade or RULE baselines net of 0.23% cost on validation.
negative_controls: shuffled-label control must NOT beat no-trade net of cost
zero-cost control reported but never used for the primary verdict

dataset.daily_price_basis_caveat: daily DB price basis UNKNOWN_CONFIRMED; feature inputs only, never return evidence

splits.embargo: rows whose max-horizon exit crosses a split boundary are dropped

environment.reward: log economic NAV change at H1 exit net of primary cost; shaped penalties reported separately and never mixed into NAV evidence

algorithm.selection: top-k by Q with k<=10 slots, no duplicate symbols
algorithm.early_stop: rolling-3 validation NAV slope negative for 3 consecutive checks

verdict_rules.GO_candidate: validation NAV > no-trade AND >= best RULE baseline at 0.23%, consistent across >=2 of 3 seeds, then untouched test evaluated ONCE
verdict_rules.NO_GO: validation fails the above, or shuffled control passes (invalidates signal), or test OOS underperforms no-trade at 0.23%
verdict_rules.post_test_retune: forbidden; any retune requires a new prereg version

oos_policy: test split is read exactly once by the final frozen checkpoint per seed; no peeking during training or model selection
forbidden: changing splits/features/costs after this freeze without a new prereg version
